description: This file is a C++ header file defining utility functions, macros, and classes related to logging, string manipulation, and IARM bus communication for the RDK platform.

classes.name: Utils::IARM
classes.description: Manages IARM bus connection status with initialization and connection check.

methods.name: Utils::IARM::isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the IARM bus is connected.

methods.name: Utils::String::find_substr_ci
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive search for a substring within a string.

methods.name: Utils::String::contains
methods.description: Checks if a string contains a given substring, case-insensitive.

methods.name: Utils::String::equal
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive comparison of two strings.

methods.name: Utils::formatIARMResult
methods.description: Formats an IARM_Result_t value into a string for error reporting.

methods.name: Utils::cRunScript
methods.description: Executes a shell script and returns its response as a string.

methods.name: Utils::isFileExistsAndOlderThen
methods.description: Checks if a file exists and was modified at least a certain number of seconds ago.
